cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get us to the wedding. Keep the hall key away from that cup of tea; the address is on the invitation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The key fell in. I used the invitation to dry it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clean the key. You read out the address before the paper tears.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The address has washed off. The paper's stuck to the key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the whole mess in the cup and call the couple. I'll explain why we've got their key but nowhere to take it.

reason: Make each original prop return altered and force a clear call for directions; A takes the embarrassing explanation while relying on B to preserve the damaged bundle and call.
